title: Hirsch equality conjecture for non-degenerate axial transportation polytopes
statement:
Let $P$ be a non-degenerate $l\times m\times n$ axial transportation polytope with $l,m,n\geq 3$. Its dimension is

$$
d=lmn-l-m-n+2.
$$

Let $f$ be the number of facets of $P$, and let $G(P)$ be its graph. **Hirsch equality conjecture.** The diameter of $G(P)$ is equal to $f-d$. The Hirsch conjecture concerns the general upper bound $f-d$ for the diameter of a $d$-dimensional polytope with $f$ facets; the supplied source does not state a resolution of this stronger equality claim, so it remains open.
source_name: Jesús A. De Loera, Edward D. Kim, Shmuel Onn and Francisco Santos, “Graphs of Transportation Polytopes”, arXiv:0709.2189 (2009).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/0709.2189

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2007).
